# m.partners.benzinga.bulls_bears_say

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Benzinga's bull case and bear case summaries for US stocks.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.bulls_bears_say(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | US stock tickers; None, the default, for no ticker filter (`dm.ALL` is refused). |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Massive's field to sort by, such as `"last_updated"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"last_updated_gte": "2025-06-01"}`. Keys: `benzinga_id`, `benzinga_id_any_of`, `benzinga_id_gt`, `benzinga_id_gte`, `benzinga_id_lt`, `benzinga_id_lte`, `last_updated`, `last_updated_gt`, `last_updated_gte`, `last_updated_lt`, `last_updated_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol for the company associated with the bull and bear case summaries." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `BearCase` | String | A concise summary of the bearish investment thesis, highlighting potential risks, challenges, and reasons why the stock could decline in value. |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The unique identifier used by Benzinga for this bull/bear case record. |
| `BullCase` | String | A concise summary of the bullish investment thesis, highlighting positive aspects, growth opportunities, and reasons why the stock could appreciate in value. |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the bull/bear case was last updated in the system. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
